title: Path of Achra
provenance: Reported by arielkapur (highball-db#1071, 2026-11-08), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 26.5.2, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 49 minutes: plays near perfect, over 55 fps at normal settings in busy fights. Esc doesn't leave the search bar, and to leave a menu with an empty search bar a character has to be typed first. The reporter closed the report. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Plays near perfect on an M5 Pro with DXMT on the default engine (r28) over 49 minutes, above 55 fps at normal settings in busy fights.

knownIssues.symptom: Esc doesn't leave the search bar, and leaving a menu with an empty search bar needs a character typed first (M5 Pro, DXMT)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed, may not be Mac specific
